name: Triage
why: A finding, from intake to the issue or card that a merged pull request closes
ideal: A finding becomes a typed issue closed within a day, or a card on the board; each closes through its merged pull request.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Linking a pull request to an issue
GitHub Docs: Best practices for Projects
GitHub Docs: Using the built-in automations

steps.name: Intake
steps.rule: Every finding arrives through an issue form with a type, so it is ready to act on.

steps.name: Issue
steps.rule: A bug or quick fix one small pull request can close in a day is a typed issue.

steps.name: Card
steps.rule: A feature is a card on the board, moved by the board's automations.

steps.name: Fix
steps.rule: A fix costs few runner minutes: one small pull request, checked once.

steps.name: Link
tools: Closing keyword in the pull request
steps.rule: Each issue or card closes through its merged pull request, so every fix is traced.
